flow: ui-toggle (composer Search / Web-access switch) + chat prompt

steps.note: button / [role='switch'] / [role='checkbox'] matching labels: search, web, web access, 搜索, 联网 — CANDIDATE selectors, verify on first live capture; composer state key selectSearch drives this switch in the bundles
if checked/state != args.enable, click to toggle web-search mode; else no-op
answer selector UNVERIFIED — confirm on first live capture
CANDIDATE — citation block selectors TBD on first live capture; RPC-side per-message refs are kimi.chat.v1.Refs / CodeReference via GetSearchCitation

rpcEquivalent: In-chat search is a tool on the chat stream: kimi.chat.v1.Tool{type:kimi.common.v1.ToolType.TOOL_TYPE_SEARCH=1, search{force}} rides inside ChatService.Chat's ChatRequest.tools — the switch's state feeds that field. Citations per message: ChatService.GetSearchCitation{chat_id,message_id} / GetToolBlock; Ref data = kimi.chat.v1.Refs / CodeReference. A separate dedicated backend search.v2.SearchService (Search/SerpSaas/Highlight/Url2Text/GetPdfMeta) exists but is NOT what the composer switch drives. No payloads verified on the wire yet.
note: toggle selector is UI-revision sensitive (state key selectSearch in bundles); re-tune per account after live capture
stealth: real session, trusted inputs, site's own send handler
